description: Binding arguments to UDF parameters declared with STRUCTURED types, matched EXACTLY in both directions (live-verified): a matching structured cast binds (field-type LENGTH ignored), plain OBJECT/VARIANT/ARRAY arguments are refused by structured parameters and structured arguments by plain ones (each naming the argument's type), a different structured type (wider, renamed, retyped, MAP) does not bind, a bare NULL binds, and a structured COLUMN binds by its declared type exactly like a cast expression. Converted 1:1 from expressions/StructuredTypeUdfArgumentTest (now retired).
